title: Fire Emergency Protocol
steps: Activate the nearest fire alarm pull station.
Begin guest evacuation via emergency stairwells.
Account for all guests at the designated muster point.
Do not re-enter the building until cleared by fire department.

title: Medical Emergency Protocol
steps: Call for on-site medical staff or 911.
Provide basic first aid if trained.
Keep the patient calm and comfortable.
Clear the area for emergency responders.

title: Security Threat Protocol
steps: Keep guests away from the threat area.
Document the incident details as soon as safe.
